REBALANCED_SPIRE_FIRST_TIME_FTUE_DESCRIP:
It looks like this is your first time playing with the 'Rebalanced Spire' mod enabled!

Since Slay the Spire 2 is still in Early Access, its balance is not yet optimal. Therefore, the goal of the 'Rebalanced Spire' mod is to adjust certain aspects of the game, such as enemies, events, relics, and cards, to improve the player experience!

Naturally, this will lower the overall game difficulty to some extent. For this reason, you can freely enable or disable any of the adjustment options in the mod configuration on the main menu, allowing you to craft your own unique gameplay experience!
REBALANCED_SPIRE_FIRST_TIME_FTUE_DISCLAI: Note: Our goal is to fix problems, not remove the fun.
